info.name: Calculate risk attribution for a portfolio over a defined time period

items.docs: Based on a specific risk model, calculate risk attribution for a specific portfolio over a time period of between 3 months and 15 years.  The response enables you to attribute portfolio risk to specific factors.

info.name: Calculate risk attribution for the individual holdings in a portfolio over a defined time period

items.docs: Based on a specific risk model, calculate risk attribution for a specific portfolio over a time period of between 3 months and 15 years.  The response enables you to attribute portfolio risk to specific holdings.
